summary: Nickname service reports overworld before field movement owns input
symptom: RAM nickname mutation succeeds, but adaptive movement remains at the NPC after dialogue dismissal

unexpected.predicted: After verified nickname and acknowledgement dismissal, movement changes player position from (12,4)
unexpected.actual: mode=overworld and field mode=0 while 32 movement replans leave position at (12,4)
diff: field_message_box_mode=0 and mode=overworld did not imply field input ownership
player remained at (12,4) through 32 bounded movement replans

authority.oracle: Party nickname and personality from decrypted RAM, field mode from EWRAM, and player coordinate delta from live map RAM

steps: Select the verified Dewford utility NPC nickname service
Rename party slot 5 and dismiss the Done acknowledgement
reproduction.observed: Both runs wrote Ohmnomnom correctly, reported overworld/mode 0, and remained at (12,4) until B released the retained script command

hypotheses.claim: The utility script retains input ownership for one command after clearing field mode
hypotheses.predicted_discriminator: One B will preserve nickname/map and make the next movement change coordinates
hypotheses.evidence_for: Two fixed-fixture runs moved to (10,4) only after one B

root_cause.claim: The custom nickname script clears visible field state before releasing its retained command/input lock
evidence: Two identical pre-fix clone runs stayed at (12,4) despite overworld/mode 0
Exactly one B preserved nickname and enabled immediate movement in both runs
alternatives_falsified: Insufficient wait: 32 adaptive replans supplied ample frames without releasing ownership
Nickname mutation failure: decrypted RAM already held Ohmnomnom with the original personality
A as cleanup: an extra A while facing the NPC reopens the service greeting

solution.contract_change: After the nickname acknowledgement reaches false-overworld, send exactly one B before proving movement ownership and returning success

targeted_checks.name: two fixed-fixture nickname service replays
targeted_checks.evidence: Both returned verified=True, Ohmnomnom, overworld, position (10,4)

regression_checks.name: nickname planner and capability catalog tests

replay.expected: Nickname changes once, identity is preserved, acknowledgement closes, and movement reaches (10,4)
replay.actual: Both runs changed only slot 5 nickname to Ohmnomnom and reached (10,4) in overworld

domain_knowledge: The Run & Bun naming screen auto-switches from uppercase to lowercase after its first character
regression_cases: Dewford utility NPC nickname service from the clean Togedemaru party checkpoint
tooling_contracts: A Center service may require an explicit retained-command release even after field mode is zero; prove movement ownership before returning
